title: Next-generation vanadium redox flow batteries: harnessing ionic liquids for enhanced performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25310-25321
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02901E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kalyan Sundar Krishna Chivukula, Yansong Zhao
A novel acid-free VRFB electrolyte utilizing BmimCl + VCl3 achieves 1.8 V stability, CE > 85%, and 7.26 Wh L−1 energy density. Demonstrates green chemistry, enhanced vanadium solubility, and stable charge–discharge performance.
